title: Janaki Nayakan
desc: Ram, a young boy, lives in a monastery waiting for Sita to return and take care of him. However, Sita returns, years later, but with an ulterior motive.

title: Baashha
desc: Bound by a promise to his late father, a gangster becomes an autorickshaw driver. However, when his past catches up with him, he must choose between succumbing to his old ways and keeping his word.

title: Mersal
desc: Maaran, a doctor, is falsely arrested for the murder of his colleague, Dr Arjun Zachariah. He soon discovers that the real culprit is a lookalike who aims to expose corruption in the medical industry.

title: Bhai
desc: A ruthless crime lord's plan to eliminate a police officer backfires when the henchman assigned to kill him discovers the target is his long-lost brother.

title: Ko
desc: Ashwin, a photojournalist, supports his friend, Vasanthan, who is contesting in the upcoming elections. However, he is shocked when he realises that Vasanthan has connections with the Naxalites.
